variables.title: DevSuperSuite v1.0 Official Production Release & Live Playground Launch
variables.body:
## ⚡ DevSuperSuite v1.0 is Officially Live!

We are excited to announce the general availability of **DevSuperSuite v1.0** — the dual developer productivity accelerator designed for engineers building with Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, and VS Code.

### 🌟 What's New in v1.0:
1. **Interactive Web Playground**: Test the real-time Shannon entropy secret analyzer and low-latency voice audio pipeline in your browser with zero installation at [atp0925.github.io/devsupersuite/#demo](https://atp0925.github.io/devsupersuite/#demo).
2. **AgentShield Pre-Commit Interceptor**: Local, offline Shannon entropy token calculation ($H(X) > 3.8\text{ bits/char}$) guarding against OpenAI, Stripe, AWS, GitHub, and custom high-entropy secret leaks.
3. **Live Voice Responder**: Full-duplex WebRTC Acoustic Echo Cancellation (-44dB) + instant "CROW" voice barge-in.
4. **Dual Settlement Support**: Global card/PayPal checkout on Gumroad and zero-fee instant UPI settlement for Indian developers.
